    • loadDatabase

      public ArchiveEntry loadDatabase(ArchiveResource database, int lazyLoadingThreshold) throws PresentationException, IndexUnreachableException
      Loads the given database and parses the EAD document. Archives with fewer nodes than the given threshold are loaded entirely in one query. Larger archives are loaded on demand: only the root and its children are built here, deeper levels are loaded from Solr when they are expanded, selected or found by a search.
      Specified by:
      loadDatabase in class ArchiveParser
      Parameters:
      database - the archive resource to load
      lazyLoadingThreshold - minimum tree size to switch to on-demand loading
      Returns:
      Root element of the loaded tree
      Throws:
      IndexUnreachableException
      PresentationException

    • loadNode

      public ArchiveEntry loadNode(int order, int hierarchy, org.apache.solr.common.SolrDocument doc, boolean loadChildrenRecursively) throws PresentationException, IndexUnreachableException
      Creates an ArchiveEntry for the given Solr document. The children of the root node (hierarchy 0) are always loaded.
      Parameters:
      order - position of this node within its parent's children
      hierarchy - depth level of this node in the tree
      doc - Solr document representing this archive entry
      loadChildrenRecursively - if true, child nodes are loaded recursively
      Returns:
      ArchiveEntry
      Throws:
      IndexUnreachableException
      PresentationException

    • searchInUnparsedNodes

      public ArchiveParser.UnparsedNodeSearchResult searchInUnparsedNodes(ArchiveEntry node, String searchValue)
      Searches the index for nodes of an on-demand loaded archive that match the given value and loads the tree path to each hit. Paths are loaded for at most MAX_UNPARSED_SEARCH_HITS hits and for at most MAX_NODES_LOADED_PER_SEARCH newly loaded nodes in total; if either limit is reached, the result is flagged as incomplete.
      Specified by:
      searchInUnparsedNodes in class ArchiveParser
      Parameters:
      node - Any node of the archive tree
      searchValue - Search terms
      Returns:
      ArchiveParser.UnparsedNodeSearchResult
